title: A2UI iframe catalog
description: A2UI catalog for embedding sandboxed web applications in a surface. `WebAppFrameUrl` loads an external URL and `WebAppFrameSrcdoc` renders inline HTML. Both components exchange `a2ui_*` messages with the host over a dedicated MessagePort to dispatch actions, keep bound data in sync in both directions, call host functions and request frame resizes. See web_app_frame_specification.md for the protocol and the security controls.

WebAppFrameUrl.description: Renders an external web application, loaded from an http or https URL, in a sandboxed iframe. The remote server is responsible for the application's Content Security Policy; the host only accepts messages that come from the URL's origin.

url.description: The external URL to load inside the iframe. Only http and https URLs are loaded. The host appends its own origin as the `origin` query parameter so the application can address its messages to the host.

WebAppFrameSrcdoc.description: Renders inline HTML, such as a model-generated application, in a sandboxed iframe with no network access. The host injects a strict Content Security Policy into the markup before rendering it.

htmlContent.description: The raw HTML string to render via srcdoc. A value prefixed with `url_encoded:` is decoded with decodeURIComponent before rendering.

JsonSchema.description: A JSON Schema. The host validates the matching payload against it before acting on the message; an empty object accepts any value.

AllowedEvents.description: A map of authorized action names to JSON Schemas describing the expected `data` payload. The host silently drops an `a2ui_action` message whose action is not listed or whose data fails validation.

AllowedFunctions.description: A map of authorized host client function names to JSON Schemas describing their expected arguments. The host rejects an `a2ui_function_call` message whose function is not listed or whose arguments fail validation. The functions must exist in the surface's catalog.

MutableData.description: A map of state keys, as declared in `data.paths`, that the embedded application is authorized to mutate in the parent data model, each mapped to a JSON Schema describing the allowed values. The host drops an `a2ui_data_model_change` message whose key is not listed or whose value fails validation.

Config.description: A dictionary of static key-value initialization properties passed to the embedded application once, in the `a2ui_app_frame_init` handshake, without reactive data model binding.

DataPaths.description: Data binding configuration for the component.

paths.description: A dictionary mapping custom state keys to distinct JSON Pointer paths in the data model. The host sends the current value of every path in the handshake and pushes an `a2ui_data_model_update` message whenever one changes.

height.description: The height of the iframe in pixels.

disableSchemaValidation.description: If true, the host skips the JSON Schema validation of `allowedEvents`, `allowedFunctions` and `mutableData` payloads and forwards them as they arrive. Origin checks and the allowlists still apply. Reserve it for trusted first-party applications; the agent backend must not set it for untrusted content.

anyFunction.description: This catalog declares no functions, so no function call validates against it.
